name: background-lights

frames.best_why: The blue-to-yellow glow is at its strongest and the hero text is fully lit above it.

tagline: A blurred blue-cyan-yellow glow rising softly behind a hero section.
summary: A wide blurred conic gradient that sweeps blue into cyan and yellow near the bottom of the screen, giving a dark hero a soft coloured glow. It is a single non-interactive backdrop layer.
appearance: A full-width, low band of soft colour along the bottom of a dark page: deep blue on the left shifting through teal to yellow on the right, blurred so no edges show. Above it sit a white headline, grey subtext and two buttons.
behaviour: Static: the blurred glow sits still and never moves or responds; the demo simply fades it in once on load.
demo_content: Headline Ship interfaces people trust, subtext about 4,200 teams, and Our work and Contact us buttons.
search_phrases: subtle bottom glow for landing page
use_when: A dark hero or section needs a soft band of colour at the bottom to lift it without a heavy image.
avoid_when: It is a fixed conic gradient at 20% opacity, so on light backgrounds the glow barely shows and the colours cannot adapt.
customise: Only className is accepted; the conic colours, blur radius and 20% opacity are hardcoded in the source, so a different palette means editing the file.
weight_why: One div painted with a blurred conic gradient; no script, no per-frame work.

a11y.note: It is a decorative empty layer with no roles; that is fine, but it carries no aria-hidden and nothing adapts for light themes.

issues: At 20% opacity the glow is barely visible on the dark stage, so the effect reads as faint.
polish_why: Soft, tasteful glow that lifts the hero; it is very faint and the palette is fixed.
